title: DNA damage-induced YTHDC1 O-GlcNAcylation promotes homologous recombination by enhancing N6-methyladenosine binding
authors: Mengyao Li; Jie Li; Aiyun Yuan; Weidong Dong; Suwei Dong; Yun-Gui Yang; Yibo Wang; Chen Wu; Jing Li
one_liner_zh: 该文研究DNA损伤诱导的YTHDC1 O-GlcNAc修饰增强其与m6A RNA结合并促进同源重组修复，涉及RNA-蛋白互作和MD模拟，但核心对象为RNA修饰阅读蛋白而非TF-DNA体系，方法上仅部分使用MD，与课题聚焦的TF-DNA互作建模关联有限。
abstract: N6-methyladenosine (m 6 A) is the most prevalent RNA modification, and its regulators include writers, readers and erasers. m 6 A is under stringent control and takes part in many biological events, but it is not known whether there is an interplay between m 6 A and glycosylation. Here we investigated an m 6 A reader, YTHDC1, which has been shown to be recruited to the DNA-RNA hybrid at DNA damage sites and regulate homologous recombination (HR) during DNA damage repair. We found that YTHDC1 is subject to O-linked β-N-acetylglucosamine (O-GlcNAc) modification at Ser396 upon DNA damage, which is pivotal for YTHDC1 chromatin binding and ionization radiation induced foci (IRIF) formation. RNA immunoprecipitation (RIP) and molecular dynamics (MD) simulations indicate that O-GlcNAcylation is vital for YTHDC1 to bind with m 6 A RNA. Fluorescence recovery after photo bleaching (FRAP) analysis revealed that YTHDC1 O-GlcNAcylation is essential for DNA damage-induced YTHDC1-m 6 A condensate formation. We further demonstrate that YTHDC1 O-GlcNAcylation promotes HR-mediated DNA damage repair and cell survival, probably through recruitment of Rad51 to the damage sites. We propose that YTHDC1 O-GlcNAcylation is instrumental for HR and genome stability.
abstract_zh: N6-甲基腺苷（m6A）是最普遍的RNA修饰，其调控因子包括写入器、读取器和擦除器。m6A受到严格调控并参与许多生物事件，但尚不清楚m6A与糖基化之间是否存在相互作用。在此，我们研究了一个m6A读取器YTHDC1，该因子已被证明在DNA损伤位点被招募至DNA-RNA杂交体，并调控DNA损伤修复过程中的同源重组（HR）。我们发现，在DNA损伤后，YTHDC1在Ser396位点发生O-连接β-N-乙酰葡糖胺（O-GlcNAc）修饰，这对YTHDC1的染色质结合和电离辐射诱导灶（IRIF）形成至关重要。RNA免疫沉淀（RIP）和分子动力学（MD）模拟表明，O-GlcNAc糖基化对YTHDC1与m6A RNA的结合至关重要。荧光漂白后恢复（FRAP）分析揭示，YTHDC1的O-GlcNAc糖基化对于DNA损伤诱导的YTHDC1-m6A凝聚体形成是必需的。我们进一步证明，YTHDC1的O-GlcNAc糖基化通过可能招募Rad51至损伤位点，促进HR介导的DNA损伤修复和细胞存活。我们提出，YTHDC1的O-GlcNAc糖基化对HR和基因组稳定性至关重要。
